title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Blue Sour Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blue Sour Raspberry serves a bright Blue Raspberry note lifted by a tangy sour edge for a punchy, confectionery-style taste. The balance of sweet and sharp keeps the profile lively without becoming overbearing. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this format combines a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers, letting the device feed the pod automatically from your chosen refill. It’s a tidy, low-upkeep setup with no manual refilling or coil changes. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt provide consistent MTL vapour, crisp flavour and quick nicotine satisfaction from start to finish. Complete your collection – see all flavours: View Hayati Pro Ultra Plus Refill Pods How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
